description: Find the signed-in user's Tineo Library Lists by title or description. Return candidate IDs; when several titles match, ask the user to select one. These are freestanding Library Lists, separate from trip packing/checklists. Only lists are supported; do not invent journal, place or file edits.

limit.description: Maximum candidates, 1..50. Omitted or zero uses 20.

name: library_lists_search
title: Find Library Lists
